about_the_game:
Western Justice tells the story of a newly appointed sheriff assigned to a lawless frontier town. The player must bring order to the chaos by taking down outlaws while overseeing the rebuilding and development of the town. The narrative unfolds through a mix of justice, conflict, and tough decisions that shape both the sheriff’s path and the town’s fate.

Town Development and Sheriff Systems:

Western Justice is more than just action. The player constructs new buildings to expand and improve the town's infrastructure, customize the sheriff's office with unique decorations, and build relationships with townsfolk to earn reputation. A strong reputation unlocks new guns, customization items, various perks, and influences how citizens react. Additionally, activities like horse races and table games add variety and replayability. Character progression is driven by the choices made throughout the game, ensuring each playthrough feels distinct.

BECOME A TRUE WILD WEST SHERIFF

Combat and Action Mechanics:

The player enforces the law through real-time shootouts, hand-to-hand combat, and reflex-based duel sequences. A lasso mechanic allows the sheriff to capture criminals alive, adding a tactical element to gameplay. Each encounter tests the player’s skills and is supported by cinematic moments that immerse the player in an authentic Wild West atmosphere.

content_descriptors.notes: There is no sexual content or drug use in our game. However, there are instances of blood shown in combat scenes. Additionally, some items (such as bottles and beer) feature alcohol-related content. These elements are included to enhance the atmosphere of the game alongside violent scenes. We want to ensure that players are aware of such content, as it may be sensitive to some.

  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Western Justice is an action simulation game combining wild west shootouts, town-building, community management, deputy assignment, and prison management. Become a sheriff, bring justice to lawless lands, save your townsfolk from gangs, and build a safe civilization in the old west.
